component.name: PlayPets
component.summary: A yard where your pets talk to each other
ペットたちがおしゃべりし合う庭
宠物们互相聊天的乐园

description.p: PlayPets is an open-source desktop pet app with four starter friends and four places to spend time together. Import compatible Codex pet files or create a background of your own. Time, weather and seasons bring the yard to life.

ul.li: Each friend talks through its own AI: a Claude Code or Codex subscription, Ollama, or an OpenAI-compatible server.
Friends answer in turn in one conversation and keep chatting among themselves.
Coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Grok Build, Qoder, Kimi Code and MCP tools) show their work as a friend's poses.
Play hide and seek, a parade or tag, or send friends out to roam the desktop.
Dig for finds, grow flowers and trees, and fish and catch bugs for the album, with no AI needed.
Friends and settings are saved on your computer. AI conversations go to the provider you connect.

description.p: PlayPets is not affiliated with OpenAI. Codex is a trademark of OpenAI.

description.p: Winter comes to the yard: roll a snowman together, follow footprints in the snow, trim the Christmas tree and read a letter from your closest friend. Then spring shoots and cherry blossoms.

ul.li: In a winter yard, roll snowballs with your friends into a snowman, then give it a hat and a scarf.
Animal footprints cross the snow; follow them with a friend to a small find in a bush.
In the winter lights, now December 1 to 31, friends bring a Christmas tree, a reindeer and Santa.
Hang up to three album finds a day on the Christmas tree.
Snowy December nights grow the tree grand; with reindeer and Santa out, a sleigh crosses the moon.
From December 26, your closest friend writes you a year-end letter, and you can write back.
In spring, shoots come up after rain; a friend digs them up for the album's new book.
At the cherry blossom festival, friends gather to view the flowers. Catch a petal for a wish.
The album holds 169 finds in eight books, with the Footprints and Spring shoots books.
Fireflies, the gudgeon, winter trees and other look-alikes are now easy to tell apart.
Claude Code and Codex CLI sign in from PlayPets, with no terminal.
Report an AI reply in About sends a short public form, without your conversation.
Friends keep every AI reply suitable for ages 13 and up.
A butterfly or dragonfly in front of a friend or a gift can be caught.
Fishing goes on when you resize the window.
The yard rests while its window is hidden, and downloads are smaller.

description.p: Your desk can have a bench now: send friends and gifts out one at a time, and a strolling friend stops by to say hello. The album grows to 150 finds.

ul.li: Right-click a friend and choose Show on desktop to send just that friend out.
Gifts go out to the desktop too, and strolling friends stop by them to say something.
Press Set out in the album to bring back any gift that came before.
A right-click on the desktop lets you talk to a friend or take it off the desktop.
The album grows to 150: new fish, bugs, flowers, trees, keepsakes and six gifts.
The album reads like a collector's notebook, with a star for each finished book.
Where a rainbow ends the ground glimmers, and a dig there always finds something.
Sunshowers, autumn mist, moonlit snow and summer meteor showers, each pointed out.
Ask a friend about the app and it answers from the app's own facts.
Fish and bugs turn up as often as they are common; event-only finds are marked rare.
A memento's heart shows for a day, then only when you point at the memento.
Downloads are smaller: the macOS disk image is about 200 MB instead of 315 MB.
Switching books in the album starts at the top of the new book.

description.p: Gifts now come from friends, not from the clock: play with a friend and it may bring you something, and growing closer brings one too.

ul.li: A gift comes at most every other day, from a friend you did something with that day.
A friend brings a gift each time it grows closer, and at Very close a memento of its own.
A gift box in the album keeps gifts that came while the yard was full.
Closeness grows from play: time with the yard open counts for up to an hour a day.
A friend fishing on its own calls you when a fish bites; press the float to reel it in.
Import a pet from a ZIP file, and remove a pet you no longer want from Invite a friend.
Cancel a pet import from an address, or an update while it downloads.
Imported backgrounds and the place, season and weather you picked stay with your data.
Connect a coding agent in one press from Settings; Qoder and Kimi Code join the list.
A Claude Code friend waits for you only when Claude asks, and says when a turn fails.
The chat log keeps up to 500 messages a session, and a friend stays itself in a long chat.
Claude Code and Codex CLI installed with nvm, fnm, Volta and others are found.
After you unplug a monitor, a window that no longer fits comes back; top buttons reset its size.
New friends share the AI you connected, and unsent words stay with the friend you wrote them to.
Fixes for saving, the tray, digging, hide and seek, trees, moving gifts and the Places buttons.

description.p: Grok moved into the yard: a friend keeps Grok Build company while it codes, and friends can chat through Grok.

ul.li: A friend reacts while Grok Build thinks, uses a tool, waits for you and finishes.
Friends can chat through Grok with an xAI API key, kept in your system's secure storage.
Grok Build also runs Claude Code and Cursor hooks; its work now shows only on its own friend.
The seed count stays inside the Plant a seed tile when the tile is narrow.
